groups.note: This entry uses actual N1904 source1:17. Actual hoi is T-NPM in both analyses, a plural personal nominalizer; LSV renders the contrasted group with singular one. No Greek numeral heis is printed here.
Actual source1:17 katangellousin is V-PAI-3P in both analyses; LSV proclaims uses singular English agreement with one. The actual Greek third-plural form is retained, not changed to a singular verb.

Contextual lexical rendering with a source-witness difference: N1904 ἐγείρειν means to raise/stir up (affliction), whereas TR ἐπιφέρειν means to bring/add (affliction), behind LSV to add. The shared affliction-causing action is linked without claiming identical Greek verbs.
